name: luxembourg-social-contributions
description: Luxembourg social security contributions (cotisations sociales) for tax year 2026, collected by the CCSS: employee and employer shares for sickness (2.80% + 0.25% cash surcharge each side), pension (8.50% each side, 17% in total from 1 January 2026), dependency (1.40%, employee only, no ceiling, after a quarter-SSM abatement), accident (0.65% times the bonus-malus factor), Mutualité des employeurs classes 1 to 4, occupational health 0.14% and family benefits 1.70% (public sector only); the SSM floor and 5x SSM ceiling for 1 January and 1 June 2026; self-employed contributions on professional income with the provisional SSM base; entry, exit and wage declarations, the monthly account statement and 10-day payment, 0.6% monthly late interest and fines. Trigger on: CCSS cotisations 2026, Luxembourg social security rates, independant cotisations, MDE classe, maximum cotisable, dependance abattement. Out of scope: luxembourg-payroll (wage tax withholding), luxembourg-income-tax, lu-cross-bor
